The_Hindu_Maharashtra.Description: Under the plan, at least one lesson on drug awareness will be introduced in the school curriculum from Class V onwards, starting the next academic year (2027).

The_Hindu_Maharashtra.Description: The present bail plea arises from the 2016 Surjagarh arson case, in which several vehicles transporting iron ore from Surjagarh mines in Maharashtra’s Gadchiroli district were allegedly set ablaze by persons associated with the banned Communist Party of India (Maoist)

The_Hindu_Maharashtra.Title: Supreme Court says inclined to cancel bail of Shiv Sena corporator accused of assaulting Thane doctors
The_Hindu_Maharashtra.Description: Case stems from an incident on July 6, when Ramesh Mhatre and others allegedly assaulted three doctors for advising to move a pregnant woman to another facility as all beds in Shastri Nagar Hospital’s NICU were occupied

The_Hindu_Maharashtra.Title: Maharashtra draft electoral roll for all 288 Assembly constituencies out; check your name on the voter list
The_Hindu_Maharashtra.Description: At least 2.08 crore voters of Maharashtra’s pre-SIR electorate have not been included in the draft electoral roll published today

The_Hindu_Maharashtra.Title: Anna Hazare hospitalised due to severe dehydration and viral infection
The_Hindu_Maharashtra.Description: Stable, under investigation, says Bombay Hospital

The_Hindu_Maharashtra.Title: Navy commissions INS Nipun to support advanced underwater operations
The_Hindu_Maharashtra.Description: The vessel is designed primarily to support deep-sea diving and underwater operations, including saturation, air and heliox diving

The_Hindu_Maharashtra.Description: Maratha quota activist Manoj Jarange Patil has launched a fresh indefinite hunger strike at Antarwali Sarati in Maharashtra’s Jalna district, issuing a September 12 deadline to grant Kunbi OBC certificates based on 58 lakh historical records. Failing this, he warned of marching the protest straight to Mumbai.

The_Hindu_Maharashtra.Title: Maratha quota: Maharastra Govt hints at willingness to discuss ‘legally valid’ demands
The_Hindu_Maharashtra.Description: Activist Manoj Jarange set a September 12 deadline for the government to accept his demands and warned of demonstrations by members of the Maratha community in Mumbai

The_Hindu_Maharashtra.Description: Their demands include improvement to mental health infrastructure, end to ‘oppressive gender-based hostel curbs’, adequate space and access to campus facilities, protection from disciplinary action for peaceful protests

The_Hindu_Maharashtra.Description: The decision follows protests by candidates who said server failures, non-responsive keyboards, software lag, automatic logouts and differences in test start times affected their performance

The_Hindu_Maharashtra.Title: Maratha protesters wave black flags at Eknath Shinde in Parbhani

The_Hindu_Maharashtra.Title: 102 Nagpur pilgrims stranded in Kathmandu after floods return home safely

The_Hindu_Maharashtra.Title: MPSC aspirant allegedly ends life in Pune, Abhijeet Dipke to visit family
The_Hindu_Maharashtra.Description: MPSC students and aspirants have been staging massive protests, particularly in cities like Pune and Chhatrapati Sambhajinagar, due to widespread anger over alleged examination irregularities, paper leaks, and delays in the recruitment process.

The_Hindu_Maharashtra.Title: ‘Why nine accused in Palghar doctor assault case are absconding?’: Bombay HC raps police
The_Hindu_Maharashtra.Description: Calling the police action “unacceptable”, Court observed that police has failed to learn from previous incident in July where a doctor was assaulted in Thane District’s Dombivli region’s public hospital

The_Hindu_Maharashtra.Title: Eknath Shinde seeks deeper Maharashtra-U.K. economic ties at House of Lords event
The_Hindu_Maharashtra.Description: Presenting Maharashtra as India’s industrial and financial powerhouse, the deputy CM said the State contributes nearly 14% of India’s GDP and attracts over 30% of the country’s Foreign Direct Investment.
